name: Kvasir-Capsule: Video Capsule Endoscopy Dataset
description: Kvasir-Capsule is an open-access video capsule endoscopy (VCE) dataset collected by Simula Research Laboratory and Bærum Hospital in Norway, published in Nature Scientific Data. Providing unconstrained visual insights into the human small intestine, the dataset comprises 47,238 labeled bounding frames and 117 video sequences from capsule endoscopy examinations. Annotations span 14 distinct pathological and anatomical classes, including vascular lesions (angiectasia), inflammatory changes (ulcers, erosion, erythema), luminal blood, polypoid lesions, and standard anatomical markers (ileocecal valve, pylorus). Kvasir-Capsule enables computer vision researchers to develop automated abnormality detection algorithms that alleviate the labor-intensive burden of reviewing multi-hour capsule videos.
